name: JV_SYSTEM_OPTIONS
description: This table contains the joint venture system options.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GL_TRANSACTION_DATE_FIELD
columns.description: Indicates the descriptive flexfield date column in general ledger that will contain the date to be used as the transaction date.

columns.name: SLA_TRANSACTION_DATE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the supporting reference short name in subledger accounting that will reference the date to be used as the transaction date.

columns.name: ENABLE_PPM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether Project Management supporting reference tracking is enabled for Joint Venture Management.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the project ID to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: TASK_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the task ID to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_TASK_NUMBER
columns.description: The overriding task number associated with all joint ventures.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the expenditure type ID to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the overriding expenditure type associated with all joint ventures.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ORG_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the expenditure organization ID to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ITEM_DATE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the expenditure item date to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_BU_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the short name of the supporting reference in subledger accounting that is used to assign the expenditure business unit ID to the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_ITEM_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the supporting reference short name in subledger accounting that will reference the Expenditure Item ID to be used to associate expenditure item information to the transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the supporting reference short name in subledger accounting that will reference the Expenditure Category ID to be used to associate expenditure category information to the transaction.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SEGMENT_LABEL_CODE
columns.description: The segment label used to identify the primary segment for selecting and associating transactions to a joint venture.

columns.name: DEFAULT_GL_DATE_CODE
columns.description: The code to identify the default transaction date assigned to joint venture transactions from the general ledger. It is based on the ORA_JV_DEFAULT_GL_DATE_CODE lookup values like General ledger effective date, System date, and so forth.

columns.name: DEFAULT_SLA_DATE_CODE
columns.description: The code to identify the default transaction date assigned to joint venture transactions from subledger accounting. It is based on the ORA_JV_DEFAULT_SLA_DATE_CODE lookup values like Accounting date, System date, and so forth.

columns.name: PROJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: This column is obsolete and no longer used.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_NOT_DISTRIBUTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether transactions with status "Not distributable" will be excluded from the system.

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: The email subject line for Joint Interest Billing reports delivered using email.

columns.name: EMAIL_BODY
columns.description: The body of the email for Joint Interest Billing reports delivered using email.

columns.name: CARRIED_INTEREST_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether carried interest processing is enabled for Joint Venture Management.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_RPTG_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether processing is enabled for stakeholder reporting books.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
